## Objective
- Make the MTD quiz full screen with normal page scroll and no inner scroll container so the bottom “Before continuing” banner does not clip at 1280x720 and 1024x540.
- Apply the original site’s link and button/option-card interaction states to shared quiz classes, minimally, without committing.

## Important Details
- Repo root is `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo`; serve it with `python3 -m http.server 8150` and open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Quiz entry is `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`, generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Quiz styles live in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`; the quiz runs inside an iframe.
- The clipped banner is the bottom “Before continuing” banner shown on question 2 after answering “Yes, but I have not shared it with them yet”.
- Link states needed: default, hover, focus-visible, active.
- Button/option-card states needed: default, hover, pressed, focus.
- All state changes must be set once on the shared class, never per instance.
- States should follow the original site `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` and the repo’s link guideline.
- Changes must be minimal, avoid unrelated files, leave no debug code, and not commit.
- Playwright is available in `node_modules` for browser verification.
- `python3 ~/.agents/bin/start-card.py` failed with `No such file or directory`; treated as unavailable rather than blocking.

- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` partially and identified route/process guidance.

- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: generator for the variant; preserve the pipeline and avoid direct generated-file edits.

- `AGENTS.md`: repo process, link, and interaction constraints.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: repo routing/process guidance.

<content>
1: /* Keep the embedded quiz flush with its own content so the iframe never grows
2:    an inner scrollbar. Same-origin static hosting: read the document height and
3:    follow the quiz's own screen-change event. Under file:// the read is blocked
4:    by the browser's opaque origin; the CSS min-height then keeps the frame
5:    usable. */
6: (function () {
7:   var frame = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-frame");
8:   if (!frame) return;
9:   var timer = 0;
10: 
11:   function fit() {
12:     try {
13:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );
20:       if (height > 0) {
21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);
22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }
25:       }
26:     } catch (error) {
27:       /* file:// opaque origin: leave the CSS min-height in place */
28:     }
29:   }
30: 
31:   function soon() {
32:     window.clearTimeout(timer);
33:     timer = window.setTimeout(fit, 50);
34:   }
35: 
36:   function watch() {
37:     fit();
38:     window.setTimeout(fit, 300);
39:     window.setTimeout(fit, 1200);
40:     try {
41:       var win = frame.contentWindow;
42:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
43:       if (!win || !doc || win.__mtdHeightWatch) return;
44:       win.__mtdHeightWatch = true;
45:       win.addEventListener("mtd-quiz:event", soon);
46:       var observer = new MutationObserver(soon);
47:       observer.observe(doc.documentElement, {
48:         subtree: true,
49:         childList: true,
50:         attributes: true,
51:         characterData: true,
52:       });
53:       if (window.ResizeObserver) {
54:         new ResizeObserver(soon).observe(doc.body || doc.documentElement);
55:       }
56:     } catch (error) {
57:       /* file:// opaque origin */
58:     }
59:   }
60: 
61:   frame.addEventListener("load", watch);
62:   window.setInterval(fit, 250);
63:   window.addEventListener("resize", soon);
64: })();

## Objective
- Make the MTD quiz render full-screen with normal page-level scrolling and no inner scroll container, so the bottom “Before continuing” banner is not clipped at 1280x720 and 1024x540.
- Apply the original Sage site’s link and button/option-card interaction states to the shared quiz classes minimally, without committing.

## Important Details
- Repo root is `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo`; serve with `python3 -m http.server 8150` and open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Playwright is available in `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo/node_modules`.
- Build rule: do not hand-edit `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` or `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-b/index.html`; edit source files and re-run `node ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`, optionally `--check`.
- Working tree was clean; recent WIP commits include: `affe2e28`, `0c575723`, `5516e000`, `5dfa2819`, `2c29d76f`.
- Prior diagnosis: banner clipping is likely caused by `.mtd-quiz-modal` panel `overflow: hidden` and/or iframe `max-height` clamp, forcing inner iframe scrolling at 1280x720 and 1024x540.
- Exact current `overflow`, `max-height`, close-button, and scrollbar rules have not yet been fully confirmed because the CSS reads are still truncated.
- Newly confirmed from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` lines 1-80:
  - `.mtd-quiz-banner`, `.mtd-quiz-section`, `.mtd-quiz-frame` styling already read.
  - `.mtd-quiz-frame` has `min-height: 640px`.
  - Lines 72-75: `/* Variant A: the quiz in a dialog opened from the hero CTA. */`, `.mtd-quiz-modal[hidden] { display: none; }`.
  - Lines 77-80 begin `.mtd-quiz-modal` with `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9`, then truncates.
- Newly confirmed from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` lines 1-44:
  - Header says it applies only to Variant A modal when page carries `.mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a`.
  - Injected into same-origin quiz iframe by `variant-quiz.js`.
  - Uses frozen-bundle stable selectors: `Questions-styles__*` and suffixes `fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`.
  - Defines `@font-face` for `Sage Headline` and `Sage Text` from `https://fonts.sage.com/...`.
  - Sets `html, body { background: #000; }`.
  - Comment says `quiz-page.css` clamps the iframe and a thin scrollbar rule follows; the rule itself is truncated.
- `variant-quiz.js` constants: `FRAMES = ["mtd-quiz-frame", "mtd-quiz-modal-frame"]`, `ENTRY = /start your mtd check/i`, `TRIES = 40` at 250ms intervals.
- `variant-quiz.js` advances past the entry card, injects `variant-quiz-figma.css` for Variant A, fits iframe height, rewrites progress fill as `%`, swaps Q1 icons to 60px light set, hides helper line and support CTA.
- `quiz-frame.js` reads `frame.contentDocument` `documentElement.scrollHeight` / `body.scrollHeight`, min 640, sets `frame.style.height`, listens for `mtd-quiz:event`, MutationObserver, ResizeObserver; uses `win.__mtdHeightWatch` guard; debounced 50ms; initial fits at 0/300/1200ms; has `file://` opaque-origin fallback.
- `quiz-modal.js` opens/closes `#mtd-quiz-modal`, triggers via hero `.score-stripe h1` area and `[data-mtd-quiz-trigger]` or `a.button-checkout`, sets `aria-haspopup=dialog`, `aria-controls=mtd-quiz-modal`, includes focus trap, Esc close, focus return, and inert background.

  - `3767:2716`: Variant A before click.
  - `3776:6405`: Variant A modal open.
  - `3795:3228`: Variant B inline.
- Required interaction states:
  - Links: default, hover, focus-visible, active.
  - Buttons / option cards: default, hover, pressed, focus.
- `skills/shared/states.md` requires the full state set to be written before editing.
- States should match the original Sage site behavior and the repo’s link guideline.
- Changes must be minimal, avoid unrelated files, avoid debug code, and remain uncommitted.
- `python3 ~/.agents/bin/start-card.py` was unavailable earlier and is not blocking.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed repo layout, MTD directory structure, clean tree, and WIP commit history.
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` and `skills/shared/states.md`; confirmed full state-set requirement.

### Active

- Confirm the exact scrollbar/close-button/iframe clamp rules after line 44 of `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`.

### Blocked

- Remaining unknowns:
  - Exact `overflow`, `max-height`, close-button, and scrollbar rules in the unread CSS tails.
  - Exact stable-class mapping needed for shared link, button, and option-card state rules, though candidate stable tokens are known.

## Next Move
1. Read the unread tail of `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` beyond line 80 and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` beyond line 44 to confirm the exact rules controlling modal overflow, iframe max-height, scrollbar, and close-button behavior.

part.text:
## Objective
- Make the MTD quiz render full-screen with normal page-level scrolling and no inner iframe scroll container, so the bottom “Before continuing” banner is not clipped at 1280x720 and 1024x540.
- Apply the original Sage site’s link and button/option-card interaction states to shared quiz classes minimally, without committing.

## Important Details
- Repo root: `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo`; serve with `python3 -m http.server 8150`; verify against `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Playwright is available in `/content/bakeoff/quizrepo/node_modules`.
- Do not hand-edit generated pages `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` or `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-b/index.html`; edit source files and re-run `node ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`, optionally `--check`.
- All changes must remain uncommitted and minimal; avoid debug code and unrelated files.
- Required target viewports: 1280x720 and 1024x540; the “Before continuing” banner must be fully visible without an inner scroll container.
- `skills/shared/states.md` requires writing rest, hover, focus, and active states before editing any of them.
- Required interaction states:
  - Links: default, hover, focus-visible, active.
  - Buttons / option cards: default, hover, pressed, focus.
- Confirmed from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`:
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal[hidden] { display: none; }`
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal` is fixed, inset 0, z-index 9999, flex-centered, padding 24px.
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal-backdrop` is absolute inset 0 with `background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)`.
  - `.mtd-quiz-modal-panel` is relative flex column, `width: min(1200px, 100%)`, `max-height: calc(100vh - 48px)`, `overflow: hidden`, `border-radius: 16px`, background `var(--theme-background-color)`.
  - Base `.mtd-quiz-modal-panel .mtd-quiz-frame` is `flex: 1 1 auto`, `height: calc(100vh - 192px)`, `min-height: 0`, `border-radius: 0`.
  - Mobile `@media (max-width: 767px)` sets `.mtd-quiz-modal` padding 16px and `.mtd-quiz-modal-panel` `max-height: calc(100vh - 32px)`.
- Figma-A-specific modal rules are in the same file around lines 285–418, including `.mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-panel`, `...panel .mtd-quiz-frame`, and close-button rules; exact values are not yet fully read.
- Confirmed from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`:
  - Applies only to Variant A when the page carries `.mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a`.
  - Injected into the same-origin quiz iframe by `variant-quiz.js`.
  - Defines thin `html` scrollbar styling.
  - Sets `main.solution-finder-host { background: #000; min-height: 0; height: auto; overflow: visible; }`.
  - Defines type custom properties: `--quiz-title-font`, `--quiz-question-font`, `--quiz-answer-font`, `--quiz-body-font`, `--quiz-small-font`, `--quiz-font-family`.
  - Flattens frozen-bundle gutters using stable selectors such as `main.solution-finder-host [class*="fGtfKe"]`, `[class~="kyStRA"]`, `[class~="hnTQsX"]`, and `[class~="lScyZ"]`.
- Candidate stable quiz tokens/classes seen in CSS or bundle references include: `fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`, `StyledHeading`, `StyledProgress`, `StyledBack`, `StyledQuestions`, `StyledButton`, `klpehu`, `sc-fsYeqr`, `cdfGlC`.
- `variant-quiz.js`:
  - Constants: `FRAMES = ["mtd-quiz-frame", "mtd-quiz-modal-frame"]`, `ENTRY = /start your mtd check/i`, `TRIES = 40` at 250ms intervals.
  - Advances past the entry card, and for Variant A injects `variant-quiz-figma.css`, fits iframe height, rewrites progress fill as `%`, swaps Q1 icons, hides helper line and support CTA.
- `quiz-frame.js`:
  - Fits the iframe to same-origin quiz content height using `documentElement.scrollHeight` and `body.scrollHeight`, minimum 640.
  - Updates `frame.style.height` only when the change is > 1px.
  - Re-fits on `mtd-quiz:event`, MutationObserver, ResizeObserver, with debounce 50ms and initial fits at 0/300/1200ms.
  - Leaves CSS `min-height` intact under `file://` opaque-origin read failures.
- `quiz-modal.js`:
  - Controls `#mtd-quiz-modal`; trigger lookup uses `.score-stripe h1` closest `.score-stripe`, then `[data-mtd-quiz-trigger]` or `a.button-checkout`.
  - Close buttons match `[data-mtd-modal-close]`.
  - Sets `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-controls="mtd-quiz-modal"`, traps focus, closes on Esc, returns focus, and uses inert background behavior.
- “Before continuing” is referenced in:
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/Brief/MTD_Quiz_Content_Brief_Phase1.md`: Step 2 accountant warning.
  - `ongoing_project/MTD/page/quiz/assets/index-DhlXhpMI.js`: frozen quiz bundle generates quiz state and warning copy.
- The quiz content is a frozen React bundle and should not be edited directly.
- Close-button pinning problem: if the panel becomes the scroll container, an absolutely positioned close button inside the panel can scroll out of view. Candidate solution is a sticky close button or a header outside the scroll region, but DOM order and Figma-A close-position values still need confirmation.
- Wide-screen constraint: the panel may be centered at large widths, so the close button should track the panel corner rather than the modal corner to avoid regressing wide-viewpoint Figma behavior.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed repo layout, MTD directory structure, clean tree, WIP commits, and uncommitted constraint.
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` and `skills/shared/states.md`; confirmed required rest/hover/focus/active sets.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js` sufficiently to confirm iframe fit logic.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js` sufficiently to confirm modal open/close, trigger, focus, and inert behavior.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` enough to confirm build command and variant mapping.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/verify.json`; existing checks do not cover required 1280x720 and 1024x540 cases.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/index.html` and identified it as frozen reference only.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` enough to confirm font tokens, black host, stable-token strategy, scrollbars, and flattened gutter rules.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` lines 80–167 and confirmed base modal, backdrop, panel, close button, frame, and mobile panel `max-height` rules.
- Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` lines 44–100 and confirmed thin scrollbar rules, host overflow, `:root` font properties, and stable token selectors.
- Searched for “Before continuing” and located brief and frozen bundle references.
- Searched `mtd-quiz-modal`/`data-mtd-modal-close` and mapped relevant CSS lines, including Figma-A panel/frame/close rule locations.

### Active
- Confirm exact Figma-A modal panel, frame clamp, and close-button rules in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`, especially around lines 285–418.
- Confirm exact close-button DOM placement in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Decide whether to pin the close button with sticky positioning, move it to a non-scrolling wrapper, or restructure the modal header.
- Implement full-screen modal/quiz behavior:
  - panel-level scrolling instead of iframe internal scrolling.
  - remove or neutralize the iframe `max-height` clamp.
  - preserve normal page-like scrolling and banner visibility.
- Identify the exact shared link, button, and option-card selectors in the frozen quiz DOM or stable token classes.
- Add complete default/hover/focus-visible/active or pressed state sets minimally.
- Rebuild variants and verify at 1280x720 and 1024x540 with Playwright.

### Blocked
- No hard blocker.
- Remaining unknowns:
  - Exact Figma-A close-button positioning and DOM order.
  - Exact Figma-A iframe `max-height` values and which rule is active in the required viewports.
  - Exact stable selectors for all links, buttons, and option cards needing shared interaction states.
  - Exact original Sage site link/button state values to mirror.

## Next Move

A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung.
